csv.title: Import issues from CSV
csv.help: Paste or upload a CSV with a header row. Required columns: magazine, issue. Optional: date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), issue_title. Existing issues get their date and title updated.
csv.createMissing: Create magazines that don't exist yet (default root folder and profile)
csv.result.title: Import finished

unmapped.empty: No unmapped files. Every file found by the last scan was matched.
rootFolders.title: Root folders
rootFolders.help: Folders that hold your magazines. Each magazine gets its own folder inside one of these.
rootFolders.add.label: Add a root folder
naming.title: Folder and file naming
naming.help: Patterns for the folders and file names Magarr will use when it imports issues.
naming.yearFolder.hint: Optional, e.g. {year}. Blank (the default) keeps every issue directly in the magazine folder, which readers such as Komga treat as one series.
naming.replaceIllegal.hint: Replace characters like / and * with safe ones instead of removing them.
naming.colon.hint: What a ':' in a title becomes.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.help: Order qualities from most to least preferred. Upgrades stop once the cutoff quality is reached.
profiles.delete.title: Delete quality profile

prowlarr.title: Prowlarr
prowlarr.help: Use the indexers you already have in Prowlarr. Sync adds each Prowlarr indexer that carries books or magazines; Prowlarr stays in charge of their settings.
indexers.title: Indexers
indexers.empty: No indexers yet. Add a Newznab or Torznab indexer, or sync them from Prowlarr.
indexers.fromProwlarr: This indexer comes from Prowlarr. Its connection settings follow Prowlarr on every sync; categories, priority, tags and enabled are yours to change.
indexers.field.name: Name
indexers.field.categories.hint: Newznab categories to search. 7010 is Books/Mags on most indexers.
indexers.field.tags.hint: If set, only magazines with a matching tag use this indexer.
indexers.validation.name: Name is required
indexers.validation.url: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
indexers.column.name: Name
indexers.delete.title: Delete indexer
indexers.delete.prowlarr: Delete {name}? It comes from Prowlarr and will be added again on the next sync unless you disable it in Prowlarr.
search.grab.rejected: Rejected: you will be asked to confirm
search.force.title: Grab a rejected release?
search.force.message: Magarr rejected this release: {reasons}. Grab it anyway?
profiles.terms.hint: Text matches anywhere, ignoring case. Wrap in slashes for a regular expression, e.g. /\bTrue ?PDF\b/. Press Enter after each.
clients.help: Grabbed releases go to the first enabled client for their protocol (lowest priority number first).
clients.empty: No download clients yet. Add SABnzbd for Usenet or qBittorrent for torrents.
clients.field.name: Name
clients.failed.title: Failed downloads
clients.failed.redownload.hint: When a download fails, blocklist that release and grab the next-best one automatically.
clients.delete.title: Delete download client
clients.delete.message: Delete {name}? Downloads already sent to it stay in the client.
generate.firstNumber.hint: Creates issues {first} to {last}. Existing numbers are skipped.
generate.start.optional.hint: If set, each issue also gets its expected {frequency} publish date.
generate.adHoc: Ad-hoc magazines have no schedule, so issues are numbered without dates.
generate.validation.number: Enter a whole number of 0 or more
queue.empty: Nothing is downloading or waiting to be imported.
queue.remove.title: Remove from queue
queue.remove.fromClient: Also delete it in the download client (and its files)
queue.remove.blocklist: Blocklist this release so it isn't grabbed again
manual.path.hint: A path Magarr can see, e.g. a download folder. Files are matched to magazines and issues where possible.
manual.warningsSelected: Some selected files have warnings (for example, not an upgrade). Importing them replaces the existing file.
importing.title: Importing
importing.help: What happens when a download finishes.
importing.auto.hint: When off, finished downloads wait in the queue for Manual Import.
importing.torrentMode.hint: Hard link (or copy) keeps the torrent seeding.
importing.removeCompleted.hint: Remove the finished item from the Usenet client and delete its folder when only junk (.nfo, .diz...) is left.
importing.recycleBin.hint: Replaced files are moved here. Leave empty to delete them.
importing.permissions.hint: Optional. Octal modes such as 664 / 775, and numeric ids. Ignored where the filesystem doesn't support them.
mappings.title: Remote path mappings
mappings.help: If a download client sees its folders under different paths than Magarr does (different machines or containers), map the client's path to Magarr's.
magazine.field.searchCutoff.hint: Automatic searches skip older issues. Leave blank to search the whole back catalogue.
clients.failed.maxRetries.hint: After this many failed downloads of the same issue, Magarr stops trying and waits for you.
wanted.help: Monitored issues without a file. Magarr searches for these automatically: new releases through RSS sync, older ones a batch at a time in the backlog search.
wanted.help.missing: Issues without a file that aren't monitored, so Magarr doesn't look for them. Mark them wanted to have them searched for.
wanted.empty: Nothing is wanted. Monitor issues (or whole magazines) to have Magarr look for them.
wanted.empty.missing: Every issue without a file is monitored.
wanted.searchQueued: Searching {count} issue(s) in the background. Grabs appear in Activity.
calendar.help: Issues by publish date. Upcoming issues of monitored magazines are added automatically.
automation.title: RSS sync and searching
automation.help: How Magarr finds new issues on its own. Only monitored magazines and monitored issues are searched for.
automation.monitoring.hint: Off pauses RSS sync, the backlog search and adding upcoming issues. Downloads already started carry on.
automation.paused.title: Automation is paused
automation.paused.body: Magarr isn't looking for new issues. Turn on automatic searching below to resume.
automation.rssInterval.hint: How often each indexer's newest releases are checked. 0 turns it off; at least {min} minutes otherwise.
automation.backlogInterval.hint: How often a batch of older wanted issues is searched for. 0 turns it off; at least {min} minutes otherwise.
automation.batchSize.hint: Each issue is searched at most once a day, so large backlogs are worked through over several days without hitting indexer limits.
automation.lookahead.hint: Upcoming issues are added as wanted up to this far ahead, following each magazine's frequency, so early releases are caught.
automation.jobs.help: When each job last ran since Magarr started.
magazine.field.grabNewSpecials.hint: When RSS sync sees a special of this magazine that isn't in the library (a Christmas special, a handbook), add it and grab it.
notifications.help: Messages to Discord, Slack, ntfy, Pushover or any webhook when Magarr grabs, imports, upgrades or fails, and when a health check finds a problem.
notifications.empty: No notifications yet. Add one to hear about new issues without opening Magarr.
notifications.template.hint: First line is the title, the rest the message. Leave blank for the default shown.
notifications.delete.title: Delete notification?
health.checked: Checked {when}. Checks run every 15 minutes; new problems are sent to notifications.
health.ok.title: Everything is healthy
health.ok.body: Root folders, indexers, download clients, imports and notifications all look fine.
backup.help: A backup holds the database and config.yaml. One is made every week (the last 7 are kept); restoring makes a backup of the current state first, then restarts Magarr.
backup.column.name: Backup
backup.restore.title: Restore this backup?
backup.restore.message: Magarr will go back to {name}: anything changed since is lost (a backup of the current state is kept). Magarr restarts to do this.
backup.delete.title: Delete backup?
backup.restarting.title: Restarting Magarr
backup.restarting.body: Applying the backup. This page reloads when Magarr is back.
